description: Incident response plan is not developed, documented, and implemented to provide an organized approach to responding to security incidents.
applicability: This signal applies to: Cloud Service Providers seeking FedRAMP authorization Federal agencies using cloud services Third-party assessment organizations (3PAOs) Systems processing federal information

metadata.detection_notes: Detection guidance: Look for missing incident response plan documentation, absence of response procedures and workflows, lack of defined roles and responsibilities, and missing communication plans for incident response.
